target_concept: Define Gaussian mean and variance in the VAE latent space and state their significance for image reconstruction

mcq.questionText: In the context of a variational autoencoder, what does the Gaussian mean in the latent space represent?
options: The average (central) latent representation of the input data
The spread (uncertainty) of latent variables around the mean
The reconstruction loss value computed during training
The activation function used in the decoder network
mcq.correctAnswer: The average (central) latent representation of the input data
mcq.explanation: The mean of the Gaussian distribution parameterizes the central tendency of the latent variables, i.e., the average location of the encoded data point. This central representation guides the decoder to reconstruct an image that resembles the original input.
